t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 6 different colours of gnomes, each of which are linked to 1 of 2 colours of basket. Red, pink and purple correspond to the red basket. The blue, yellow and orange gnomes correspond to the yellow basket. Continue to pick the colours that correspond to the same basket colour (red or yellow) until you see a decrease in the number of mushrooms. Once you see the decrease, move onto the other coloured basket

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 colours of gnome. 4 of the colours relate to the red basket, the other 4 relate to the yellow basket.Red basket- red, pink. purple and brown gnomesYellow basket- yellow, blue, orange and green gnomesEach round will have 2 gnomes, one which leads to the red basket and one to the yellow (for example, the purple gnome vs the blue gnome)Aim to keep selecting the same BASKET colour. Eventually the number of mushrooms will begin to dwindle, once this happens (say you're only getting 2 or 3 mushrooms per round), then switch to the other coloured basket.
